paper.title: Which Dwarf Is This? Doppeldwarf-306 and Near-Identical Instance Retrieval
paper.summary: A benchmark of 306 bronze dwarf statues shows frozen DINOv2 features find the right statue first for 93.1% of queries, and location works better as a weight than as a filter.
